020import java.util.Map;
021import java.util.Optional;
022
023/**
024 * An interface representing a PacketHandler that processes packets.
025 *
026 * @param <T> Is the instance to the packet library's internal API for creating/sending packets.
027 *
028 * @author creatorfromhell
029 * @since 6.2.0.9
030 */
031public interface PacketHandler<T> {
032
033  /**
034   * Retrieves a map of PacketFactory instances keyed by the game version supported.
035   *
036   * @return Map of PacketFactory instances where keys are the game version supported.
037   */
038  Map<String, PacketFactory<?>> factories();
039
040  /**
041   * Retrieves the identifier for the PacketHandler.
042   *
043   * @return The identifier for the PacketHandler.
044   */
045  String identifier();
046
047  /**
048   * Retrieves the name of the plugin.
049   *
050   * @return The name of the plugin as a String.
051   */
052  String pluginName();
053
054  /**
055   * Initializes the object or resource.
056   */
057  void initialize();
058
059  /**
060   * Retrieves an Optional instance of PacketFactory based on the provided version.
061   *
062   * @param version The version of the PacketFactory to retrieve.
063   *
064   * @return An Optional instance of PacketFactory if available for the given version.
065   */
066  default Optional<PacketFactory<?>> factory(final String version) {
067
068    if(!factories().containsKey(version)) {
069      return Optional.ofNullable(factories().get("1.21.11"));
070    }
071
072    return Optional.ofNullable(factories().get(version));
073  }
074
075  T internal();
076
077  /**
078   * Filters enchantments on an item stack based on packet handler requirements.
079   * Implementations can override this to remove unsupported enchantments or apply transformations.
080   *
081   * @param itemStack The item stack to filter.
082   *
083   * @return The filtered item stack with compatible enchantments only.
084   */
085  default org.bukkit.inventory.ItemStack filterEnchantments(final org.bukkit.inventory.ItemStack itemStack) {
086
087    return itemStack;
088  }
089}
